The 51 hits inside inDriver's own GitHub org are matches on the bare company name 'indrive' in documentation/README/header files — they do NOT reference the S3 bucket. Bare-brand-name strings carry no bucket-ownership signal because the company is named the same thing. This is structurally ambiguous: no positive signal for bucket attribution, but the absence of bucket-specific exact-string matches is itself only weakly negative because such strings are not the only way the bucket could be referenced.
